as_told.title: Sagan's covert meetings and contact with Kit Green

plain: Late in his career, the astronomer Carl Sagan met often with Kit Green, a CIA man interested in UFOs, and became very interested in UFOs himself. Michels says this in two episodes, without naming a source, and in one he adds that Sagan also held covert meetings, possibly about UFOs, that the public never knew about. If true, one of the best-known sceptics of UFOs would have been quietly looking into them.
